brief:
The Jerusalem District Electricity Company announced scheduled power cuts to parts of the Jdeida area in Ramallah and Al-Bireh governorate, the Ma'an news agency reported. The company said the cuts were necessary to improve service quality, ensure stable and safe power supply continuity, and develop infrastructure.

No timeline for restoration or further details on affected areas were provided in the announcement.

title: Jerusalem electricity company cuts power to Ramallah district for infrastructure work
